content: परित्यागः .²1 Leaving, quitting, abandonment, desertion, repudiation (as a wife <ab>&c.</ab>); अपरित्यागमयाचतात्मनः <ls>R. 8. 12</ls>; कृतसीतापरित्यागः <ls n="R.">15. 1</ls>. .²2 Giving up, renouncing, discarding, renunciation, abdication <ab>&c.</ab>; स्वनामपरित्यागं करोमि <ls>Pt. 1</ls> ‘I shall forego my name’; प्रापणात् सर्वकामानां परित्यागो विशिष्यते <ls>Ms. 2. 95</ls>. .²3 Neglect, omission; मोहात्तस्य (कर्मणः) परित्यागस्तामसः परिकीर्तितः <ls>Bg. 18. 7</ls>. .²4 Giving away, liberality. .²5 Loss, privation. .²6 A sacrifice. .²7 Separation from.
